definition: Formula-derived aggregate atomic-number, atomic-mass, and electronegativity statistics.
representative_examples: atomic_number_mean, atomic_number_range, atomic_mass_mean, atomic_mass_range, electronegativity_mean, electronegativity_range

definition: Formula-derived chemistry-role indicators and aggregate elemental fractions.
representative_examples: atom_count_formula, n_unique_elements, metal_count, metal_fraction, has_metal, transition_metal_fraction

definition: Fraction of atoms assigned to each element in the reduced/formula-derived composition representation.
representative_examples: frac_H, frac_Li, frac_Be, frac_B, frac_C, frac_N

definition: Available scalar QMOF metadata descriptors used without target/output columns.
representative_examples: info_natoms, info_pld, info_lcd, info_density, info_volume, info_symmetry_spacegroup_number
